prompt: A flat layered paper-cut collage in a strict handcraft design system: everything is cut from colored cardstock and hanji paper with perfectly clean cut edges — NO outline of any kind on any piece: no bright edge line, no white edge, no dark contour line. Each object is built from two to five completely flat die-cut pieces layered ON THE OBJECT ITSELF — its own silhouette, a main color piece, one or two detail pieces and a highlight piece — the object is never placed on a base, platform, pedestal, plinth or pile of paper sheets; Every upper piece sits slightly RAISED above the piece beneath it, so along EVERY boundary where two different colors meet, the upper piece casts a soft narrow warm dark-brown shadow down onto the lower piece — a gentle embossed paper relief wherever two colors touch, and this relief shadow is the ONLY depth cue. Cut economy: every scissor cut is purposeful and confident — a shape that is straight in the real object is cut with a clean STRAIGHT edge, and curves appear ONLY where the real object is actually curved. No decorative wavy edges, no bumpy wobbly outlines, no gratuitous scalloping on untextured surfaces; a rectangular block is cut as a plain rectangle, though corners may be gently ROUNDED — softly rounding a corner is natural scissor work. Shapes stay simple and chunky, no detail finer than real scissors could cut. Scalloped repeat patterns for textures like straw or waves, cut big and loose. Strictly straight-on orthographic front view, zero perspective. No volume, no curvature, no folded paper, no sculpting. Real-scissors discipline: every piece is a shape that could actually be cut with scissors from a single sheet of colored paper. EACH PIECE IS EXACTLY ONE SOLID FLAT COLOR — no gradient, no shading, no airbrush, no painted detail inside a piece; every color change is a separate stacked paper piece, even a thin line is its own paper strip. ALL pieces share one identical fine colored-paper texture. All shadows are neutral warm dark-brown paper shadows, never colored. This is one DRAMATIC COMIC ACTION PANEL filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge (full-bleed, no border): bold dynamic composition, big flat paper speed-line strips, kid-friendly and funny, never scary. Cute, round, friendly Korean picture-book characters for 3-4 year olds: big round white paper eyes with dark pupils, small pink cheek circles, simple rounded shapes, never scary. THUD! Side view, whole scene visible: ONE lion lying on its belly on the grass on the right side of the picture, facing LEFT, awake with wide-open surprised eyes and a small startled open mouth. The lion's ONE long front leg is stretched out forward along the ground toward the left, and the big round paw at the end of that SAME leg is pressed flat on the ground on the very tip of a tiny mouse's long pink tail. The paw is clearly joined to the lion's shoulder by the leg — one continuous body. The mouse stands just in front (left) of the paw, startled, tail stretched back under the paw; the mouse is not hurt, only the tail tip is under the paw; a few paper dust puffs. Only one lion, only one mouse, only one paw on the mouse's tail. The lion: a big, soft, cuddly lion made of flat paper pieces — warm honey-gold body, a big round mane of rounded persimmon-orange petal-shaped paper pieces all around its face, round ears, a cream muzzle with a small brown nose, pink cheeks, a long tail with a dark tuft. Gentle and sleepy-looking, never scary, no teeth showing. The mouse: a tiny grey-brown mouse made of flat paper pieces — round body with a cream belly, big round ears with pink insides, a small pointed snout with a black nose tip, tiny pink feet and a long thin curly pink tail, bright round eyes.  Colour mood: soft, muted, warm picture-book savanna — a pale soft cream-blue sky, gentle honey and sandy tan ground, calm sage-green grass and acacia leaves, low saturation (never saturated yellow, never orange sky). No text anywhere. Full-bleed illustration, no lime green.
